displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E7.2
meaning: Redundant high-limit relay stuck closed: the service facts call this an internal control-board error. The relay is closed when it should not be.
causes: Redundant HLO relay closed when it should not be
diySteps: Write down E7.2. E7.1 is 24 volts present on the 1st stage gas valve when it should be off. E7.2 is this relay fault
Technician: the troubleshooting step for fault 7.2 is to replace the integrated furnace control
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E7.2 stays on the control board. There is no filter step on this row.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
